scope: one eight-state relation-sheet component of claim 1533's SI/IS+NU/UN repair, projected onto the five coordinate sectors retained by claim 1537
phaseConvention: the eight-state support graph is a tree, so independent sector rephasings remove every edge phase; real weights lose no spectral generality on this isolated label component

feshbach.initialDomain: z not in {0,+w,-w} and z not in spec(D_8); the rational result is continued wherever the full resolvent is regular
feshbach.inducedOffDiagonals: all zero; the four retained primitive chain edges are unchanged
feshbach.desiredDiagonalDecision: the elimination generates neither the P diagonal A nor the I diagonal d of the protected coefficient texture; instead it generates unwanted Z and X diagonals

projectedResolvent.symmetry: the lower triangle equals the upper triangle for real weights; complex weights require the corresponding conjugate-oriented products

forbiddenSupportAndCofactor.intervalAbsenceConditionForIN: x y=0; F4 cannot vanish identically because its t^2 coefficient is one
forbiddenSupportAndCofactor.physicalCost: x=0 or y=0 deletes a required I--P or P--N chain mass
forbiddenSupportAndCofactor.effectiveOperatorSelectedCofactorPP: zero identically because deleting P isolates a zero-diagonal I row
forbiddenSupportAndCofactor.phi3ClearedNumerator: H3(t)=t F4(t)-g^2(t-v^2)(t-w^2), whose t^3 coefficient is one
isolatedEnergyConditions: G_IN(z)=0 at non-pole isolated energies satisfying F4(z^2)=0
G_PP(z)=0 at z=0 or non-pole isolated energies satisfying H3(z^2)=0
forbiddenSupportAndCofactor.interpretation: the mass-matrix cofactor of D_eff is a tautological chain zero, but the physically relevant spectral cofactor of z I-D_eff and the projected resolvent diagonal do not vanish on any open energy interval

controlledZeroEnergyLimit.conditions: x g v w nonzero, equivalently det(D_8) nonzero; the full resolvent is then regular at z=0 despite the singular auxiliary block
controlledZeroEnergyLimit.decision: the selected zero and absence of I--N return only at the isolated zero-energy point; they are not interval identities

massAndSupportDecision.recoverDesiredPAndIDiagonals: requires new auxiliary couplings to P and I or an external endpoint-selection rule; no relation among x,y,g,h,u,v,w moves the induced Z/X self-energies to P/I

boundary: This is the exact coordinate-projected resolvent of the label-level eight-state component. Without a physical lift identifying sectors, kinetic normalization, i epsilon prescription and observable external states, it is not a claimed physical propagator.
